content.value: Reduce the following matrix to its echelon form, canonical form and finally normal form (18) sequentially. $\left[ { \begin{array} { c c c c } { 0 } & { 1 } & { p } & { - 2 } \\ { 1 } & { 1 } & { q } & { 1 } \\ { 2 } & { 1 } & { 1 } & { 0 } \end{array} } \right]$ Hence find its Rank. Where p and q are the last two digits of your class roll number measured from the rightmost sequentially. (See Hints)
